verdicts.rationale: The candidate claims this is a defect where Qdrant rejects vector inserts into collections without vector config. However, structured_contract.json constraint qdrant_state_create_collection_001 explicitly documents this as intentional behavior: 'collections without vector config support payload-only operations (vector insert returns an error at use time)'. Source code confirms this is by-design: get_vector_config_or_error returns VectorNameNotExists when vector_data HashMap is empty. Developer cognition confirms payload-only collections are a supported use case where vector operations correctly fail until vectors are configured. This is not a bug but documented API semantics.
